summary: 39-year-old Indiana man fell about ten feet near Alberta Falls, suffering numerous traumatic injuries; park rangers and medics provided advanced medical care on scene, carried him by litter to Bear Lake Road, then ambulance; air ambulance flew him to Medical Center of the Rockies.
location: Alberta Falls, Glacier Gorge, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers/medics; Estes Park Medical Center ambulance; air ambulance
